title: Present and future value
idea: Money now is worth more than the same money later, because it can earn a return in the meantime.

sections.b: Future value: FV = PV × (1 + r)n. $1,000 at 5% for 10 years grows to $1,628.89.

Present value reverses it: PV = FV / (1 + r)n. $1,000 in 10 years at 8% is worth $463.19 today.

Memory hook: the Rule of 72. Years to double ≈ 72 / rate in %.

traps: Use the rate per period: a monthly problem needs a monthly rate and months.
